homepage.hero.lead.message: ExploreStamp is a stamp book you carry in your pocket. Walk into a museum, a historic site, an old railway station or a night market, check in on location, and you collect a stamp made for that place — saved to your calendar along with the photos from that day.

homepage.hero.fact.localData.message: Check-ins and photos stay on your phone

homepage.steps.pick.desc.message: Choose one of {collections} themed collections, such as old railway stations, a walk through Tainan or night-market food — or just search for a place by name.

homepage.steps.stamp.desc.message: When you arrive, tap “Check in”. The app uses GPS to confirm you're within range of the place, and the stamp goes into your stamp book.

homepage.steps.record.desc.message: Add up to 6 photos and a short note, and the visit is saved to your calendar. When you want to share, the photo and stamp can be combined into a postcard.

homepage.steps.title.message: Three steps to your first stamp

homepage.download.title.message: Start with the stop closest to you

homepage.download.body.message: ExploreStamp is available for iOS and Android. It's free and needs no sign-in. Pick a weekend and collect your first stamp at a station or library nearby.

homepage.newsletter.title.message: Where to get your next stamp — we'll write and tell you

homepage.newsletter.lead.message: We also share walking ideas for museums, historic sites and old railway stations, so a weekend outing becomes a route worth keeping.

homepage.meta.title.message: Turn every trip into a stamp

homepage.meta.description.message: ExploreStamp is a digital stamp book for travel. Check in on location at museums, historic sites, railway stations, factory tours and local food spots to collect stamps, keep your photos, and turn the day into a postcard to share.

homepage.mock.checkIn.hint.message: 86 m away · within the 250 m check-in radius

homepage.mock.postcard.photoAlt.message: Street in front of a temple in Tainan

homepage.showcase.collections.title.message: Themed routes, so you know where to go before you leave

homepage.showcase.collections.body1.message: The app currently includes {spots} places in Taiwan, Japan and Macao, organized into {collections} themed routes: old railway stations, a walk through Tainan, night-market food, Kyoto's old capital, a loop of Okinawa's main island and more.

homepage.showcase.collections.body2.message: Each route shows your progress, and one place can belong to several routes. The catalog updates in the background, so you never need to reinstall the app.

homepage.showcase.checkIn.title.message: You have to be there for the stamp to count

homepage.showcase.checkIn.body1.message: When you tap “Check in”, the app reads your location once to confirm you're within the place's check-in radius. The radius depends on the type of place — 250 m for a station, 400 m for a factory tour — and the accuracy your phone reports is taken into account.

homepage.showcase.checkIn.body2.message: Every place has its own stamp. The frame shape shows the category, and the stamp carries the place's name and the date of your first visit. Coming back doesn't give you a second stamp, but every visit is saved to your calendar.

homepage.showcase.postcard.title.message: A photo plus a stamp makes a postcard

homepage.showcase.postcard.body1.message: After checking in, pick a photo from that day and the app combines it with the stamp, the place name and the date into a portrait postcard you can send through your phone's share sheet.

homepage.showcase.postcard.body2.message: No photo? No problem — the app switches to a stamp-only layout.

homepage.more.map.desc.message: See every place on a map, with visited and unvisited places clearly marked and a filter by category.

homepage.more.calendar.desc.message: Each day uses a photo from that day as its cover, and each month shows how many stamps and new places you collected.

homepage.more.reminder.desc.message: Daily or weekends only, at a time you choose, the app suggests a place you haven't been to yet.

homepage.more.backup.desc.message: Pack your check-ins and photos into one file and import it on a new phone without creating duplicates.

homepage.more.offline.desc.message: Place data is installed with the app, so check-ins, the stamp book and the calendar all work without a connection.

homepage.more.languages.desc.message: The interface and place information are available in Traditional Chinese and English, following your system setting or chosen manually.

homepage.privacy.noLogin.desc.message: Start collecting right after you download. No email, phone number or other personal details needed.

homepage.privacy.locationOnce.desc.message: Your location is read only when you tap check in. It isn't tracked in the background or uploaded.

homepage.privacy.localData.title.message: Data stays on your phone by default

homepage.privacy.localData.desc.message: Check-ins and photos are stored in the app's own space and aren't uploaded to a server by default.

homepage.categories.title.message: {count} kinds of places, each with its own stamp

homepage.categories.lead.message: The category sets the stamp's frame and color: hexagons for historic sites, ticket shapes for railway stations, book shapes for libraries. Once you've collected a few, flipping through your stamp book shows which kinds of places you're drawn to.

homepage.privacy.title.message: Your travel record belongs to you

homepage.privacy.body.message: ExploreStamp works without signing in. Where you've been and what you photographed stay on your own phone. If accounts and cloud backup are added in the future, they'll be optional and off unless you turn them on.
